name: Bifrost
description: Bifrost is a high-performance AI gateway that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API for 20+ LLM providers, with automatic failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets, and an MCP gateway. Its web dashboard manages providers, governance, request logs, and observability.

notes.text: Sign in to the dashboard as admin with the password from /opt/bifrost_data/.env. That password is applied from the file at every start.
Basic auth protects the dashboard and admin API. /v1 calls need a virtual key in the x-bf-vk header; create one under Workspace → Governance.
Bifrost serves plain HTTP on port 8080. Keep it on a trusted network or put it behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy before exposing it.
